name: Colour Gate
tagline: Tap to climb. Match the moving gate.
description: Race up identical moving colour gates in your own lane. Tap to bounce, cross a matching shape and watch your colour change. A crash returns you to your checkpoint. Climb farthest across three quick rounds to win.
howToPlay: Tap to bounce upward. Tap steadily to hover below a gate.
Cross when the gate's shape matches yours. Each clear changes your shape.
Crashes return you to your checkpoint. Climb farthest before the clock ends.
